spec.headline: GTA 5 COSTS YOU |62¢/HR|
spec.topic: GTA V Enhanced on Steam (US, appid 3240220): $44.99 list, $19.79 now (56% off, appdetails cc=us + featured specials, checked 26 Nov 2026) ÷ HowLongToBeat main story 32.1 h (id 4064: 115,397 s, 3,411 submissions, read directly 26 Nov) = 62¢/h (full price $1.40/h). GTA VI Standard $79.99 (launch price, used since 16 Nov) ÷ 62¢ = 129.5 h → 130 h to match GTA 5's sale rate. No GTA VI hours claimed: HLTB main not settled (Rockstar's Rob Nelson ~80 h incl. optional goals; unverified 50 h reports).
